review_type: AI-assisted editorial and computational checks; no independent expert peer review

academic_review.evidence: Separate editorial consistency pass reviewed definitions, denominators, units, transformations, causal scope and special association assumptions. Resolved findings and review limitations are recorded.

curriculum_coverage.evidence: All introductory major topic groups are mapped across nine units, with the advanced association types and related practical workflows explicitly present.

worked_solutions.evidence: All 27 questions passed 119 independent numerical comparisons using Python statistics, NumPy and SciPy. Conceptual interpretations were reviewed separately.

originality.evidence: Teaching prose and synthetic problems were originally authored; source documentation informs conventions. Gate checks exact section/question duplication; no exhaustive external plagiarism scan is claimed.

simulation_behavior.evidence: All eight explorers passed 130 independent fixture comparisons and 27 interaction checks, including reset, input changes, degenerate calculations and sampling uniqueness.

mobile_reader.evidence: Cloud Chrome rendered the reader in a 390-pixel frame; its 375-pixel content width matched scroll width. Chapter navigation, rendered equations, solved-answer opening, slider changes and reset passed.

static_pages.evidence: Nine complete static chapters have unique IDs, matching content, three solutions each, correct navigation and simulation slots. Existing 57 books remain preserved.

seo_metadata.evidence: Every new chapter has a clean canonical URL, meaningful title/description, crawlable navigation, valid truthful JSON-LD and an actual sitemap entry. Drafts remain outside the sitemap.
